notes.title: We'll release a demo version of Slut Squad on Saturday!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!   
We're happy to say that [b]on Saturday at 10(AM) UTC-0 we'll release a demo version of Slut Squad. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554940/Slut_Squad?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=DemoAnnounce

Please look forward to it! Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam to get notified the moment it goes live!
